title: video.encode.status
description: Message the convertor publishes on exchange `video.events` with routing key `video.encode.status` after each stage of an encode. Both services carry a test that pins their own model to this file; change the file first, then both models.

video_id.description: Video.id -- the object key of the uploaded source, without extension.

resolutions.description: Present only when status is `ready`: one entry per rendition ffmpeg produced.

video_path.description: Present only when status is `ready`: master playlist, bucket-relative.
